name: NGC 7293 螺旋星云（上帝之眼）
orientation: east-left-north-up; row 0 south; columns increase west
status: measured survey; user Hα layer approximate cross-calibration, not precision absolute photometry

levels.label: LVM 实测光谱 + DSS2 未覆盖区回退
levels.source: Sánchez et al. 2026 SDSS-V LVM DR19 Helix corrected fiber line maps; 35.3-arcsec circular fiber-aperture values; second-order sky corrected. Unmeasured positions retain prior DSS2 detail.
levels.calibration: Per-fiber integrated flux converted to aperture-mean surface brightness; LVM Hα and [O III] λ5007 replace DSS2 values inside observed fiber circles.

levels.label: 单张 Hα 细节（近似尺度）
levels.source: User-provided Hα FITS single exposure, 600 s; filter slot 6; no absolute flux unit in source. WCS transformed to atlas TAN; private instrument/site metadata omitted.
levels.calibration: Approximate zero-intercept LVM 35.3-arcsec aperture ratio scale: 3.9169e-1 R/mean source-pixel count; 74% scatter; 2× image-noise floor; filter [N II] response unknown

stars.encoding: float32-le [X, Y, F550 W/m2/nm, Tcolour K]
stars.limits: Gaia G<15 within 2°, G<12.5 to 5.7°; Hipparcos V<7
stars.model: Black body at Ballesteros (2012) colour temperature from B−V (Gaia BP−RP inverted via DR3 Table 5.9), normalized to Bessell (1998) V=0 flux at 550 nm; observed (reddened) colours.

template.source: Case B Balmer ratios (Storey & Hummer 1995); [O III] 4959/5007 = 1/2.98; low-density [S II] 6716/6731 = 1.4; continuum EW(Hβ)=1370 Å (assumed). Other lines missing.

notes: 8° 底图为 SHASSA Hα（dR÷10 → R；131 个恒星残差像素用 5×5 中值替换，负值置 0）。SHASSA 的 32 Å Hα 滤镜含部分 [N II] 6548/6583，按 Hα 处理（与 7 nm Hα 滤镜的观感一致）。
细节层（2°，4.7″/像素）用 DSS2 红片的形态：按 Gaia/Hipparcos 位置遮掉 41806 个恒星像素并以平滑背景填补，扣除天空后按 SHASSA 拟合 R = a·(底片值)^γ（γ = 1.09，自由拟合 1.09，散布 0.16 dex）。

积分“Hα”通量 2.44e-9 erg/cm²/s（SHASSA 自身背景扣除后约 2.3×10⁻⁹），是文献纯 Hα 的 2.5–3.6 倍（LVM Hβ×2.86 = 6.81e-10，O'Dell 1998 = 9.64e-10）。原因主要是 [N II] 6548/6583：Helix 的 [N II]6583 与 Hα 相当，SHASSA 的 32 Å 滤镜部分透过，7 nm Hα 滤镜则全部透过，所以按 SHASSA 值保留（代表 Hα 滤镜看到的亮度）；也可能含 SHASSA 自身的定标误差。
[O III] 为估计：DSS2 蓝片（含 [O III] 4959/5007 与约 15% 的 Hβ）的形态，按同一底片幂律，总量定为文献绝对通量 F([O III]5007) = 1.18×10⁻⁹ erg/cm²/s（LVM；O'Dell 1998 为 1.94×10⁻⁹）。

LVM DR19 second-order sky-corrected Hα/[O III] fiber data replace DSS2 estimates within measured 35.3-arcsec apertures; outside those circles the DSS2 morphology remains an estimate/fallback. The 8° SHASSA Hα base remains unchanged. 66423 Hα and 49483 [O III] pixels are directly covered; only [O III] in measured footprints is spectroscopic.
用户单张 Hα 经 TAN-SIP 对齐。亮度尺度为穿零的近似 LVM aperture ratio（1463个高于背景噪声阈值的光纤，散布约74%）；affine诊断出现负截距，说明存在背景/尺度差异。输入滤镜slot 6的通带未提供，可能漏入[N II]，相对纯Hα偏差未知；不应按精密绝对测光使用。更细用户Hα与粗LVM Hα按图集LOD权重混合取代，不相加。
